verdict.rationale: Subtasks and task dependencies are a fair question for a work-management product like monday.com, but the pack has no first-party documentation of subitems, dependency links, or blocking order. The nearest items are linking GitHub/GitLab pull requests to items, which is a different capability, and one community complaint that ticket linking is unreliable, which does not document subtasks or dependency ordering.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear
